newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Midwest hogs sell steady-off $0.50 - trade.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Midwest hogs sell steady-off $0.50 - trade.

text.p: U.S. Midwest direct cash hogs Wednesday sold steady to $0.50 per cwt lower amid large marketings early, livestock dealers and packer buyers said.

Iowa and southern Minnesota hogs were trading at $55.50 to $56.00 in the country and plants were paying $57.00 to $58.00, although $58.50 was still possible on hogs delivered to the door, sources there said.
Illinois hog buyers said country points were paying $55.00 to $57.00 and plants were paying up to $58.00. Indiana hogs sold at $54.50 to $55.00 in the country and $56.50 at plants.
